key.name: aod-enabled
key.summary: Always-on clock on the lock screen
key.description: Without it the phone suspends fully (NetworkManager then disconnects).

key.name: wifi-standby
key.summary: Wi-Fi while the always-on clock shows

key.name: wifi-standby-minutes
key.summary: Minutes in the always-on clock before Wi-Fi turns off (off-after)

key.name: bluetooth-standby
key.summary: Bluetooth off while the phone sleeps
key.description: Unless a device is connected (a headset); on again when the screen wakes.
